description: This file provides a stub implementation of a Supabase client, used to prevent import errors after removing Supabase from the backend. It includes classes and functions that mimic the interface of a real Supabase client but all network operations return a 501 Not Implemented response, indicating that Supabase has been deprecated and replaced with direct database access.

classes.name: _StubResponse
classes.description: A minimal HTTP-like response class that mimics the behavior of httpx.Response, used to simulate responses for the stub Supabase client.

classes.name: SupabaseClient
classes.description: A stub class representing a Supabase client with methods that return 501 Not Implemented responses, used as a placeholder after Supabase removal.

methods.name: _StubResponse.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the stub response with a status code and payload, encoding the payload as JSON or string.

methods.name: _StubResponse.json
methods.description: Returns the JSON payload stored in the response.

methods.name: _StubResponse.raise_for_status
methods.description: Raises an error if the status code indicates a failure.

methods.name: SupabaseClient.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the stub Supabase client with a mode and optional token.

methods.name: SupabaseClient.anon_mode
methods.description: Creates a stub client in anonymous mode.

methods.name: SupabaseClient.user_mode
methods.description: Creates a stub client with a user token.

methods.name: SupabaseClient.admin_mode
methods.description: Creates a stub client with admin privileges.

methods.name: SupabaseClient.get
methods.description: Stub method for GET requests; returns a 501 response.

methods.name: SupabaseClient.post
methods.description: Stub method for POST requests; returns a 501 response.

methods.name: SupabaseClient.upsert
methods.description: Stub method for upsert operations; returns a 501 response.

methods.name: SupabaseClient.close
methods.description: No-op method for closing the client.

methods.name: get_supabase
methods.description: Function that returns None, indicating Supabase has been removed.

methods.name: parse_bearer
methods.description: Extracts the token from a Bearer authorization header.

methods.name: decode_supabase_jwt
methods.description: Returns an empty dictionary; JWT handling via Supabase is not used.
